decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter fits the firm's strategic push into organic lines and sits close to its core salami competence, though its brief mention on the website suggests lower prominence and some risk of being delisted in retail.
The organic poultry mini salami snack has its own page and matches both the organic expansion and the growing snacking trend, making it a strategic product worth keeping.
The premium sharing salami snack has its own page, uses existing curing and maturation capabilities, and targets the convenient snacking demand in a growing market.
